analysis_eligibility.purpose: research-quality aggregation guardrail; not a statistical-significance threshold

methodology.buckets: original X rank quantiles; 10 buckets at n>=50, 5 at n>=25, 2 at n>=10, otherwise 1; floor(index * buckets / n)

country_analysis_eligibility.purpose: research-quality aggregation guardrail; not a statistical-significance threshold

methodology.final_rank_ic: Spearman correlation of negative recorded final rank and forward return
methodology.membership: immutable X population first; attach Y afterward without replacements
methodology.primary_question: Does ranking add value within the same X universe and production constraints?
methodology.score_ic: Spearman correlation of recorded total score and forward return
